name: OpenClaw
summary: Merge a Diffusion provider into the OpenClaw gateway configuration.
statusNote: Preserve channels, plugins, and your existing default model; the merge mode keeps them intact.
prerequisites: OpenClaw installed with an existing working configuration.
A Diffusion Router API key from API keys.

setup.title: Merge the Diffusion provider
setup.body: The models.mode merge value keeps existing models; JSON5 comments are preserved when the file uses them.

setup.title: Export your Diffusion key
setup.body: Add the export to your shell profile and open a new terminal.

restart: Restart the OpenClaw gateway so the merged provider loads.

verification.title: List models through the gateway
verification.body: The Diffusion entry must appear next to your existing models.

troubleshooting: 401/403: check the key and tenant binding in API keys.
Models missing: confirm mode is merge (not replace) and the JSON/JSON5 still parses.
Default model changed unexpectedly: set your previous default explicitly after merging.

removal.title: Remove the Diffusion provider
removal.body: Delete the models.providers.diffusion block and unset the key. Revoke the key in API keys if unused.

rollback: Restart the gateway; channels and plugins are untouched by this guide.
